items.c: Happy New Year from all of us at Cedar Ridge! 🎉 We can't wait to worship with you this Sunday. On January 10 we begin Vision 2035, a look at where God is leading our church. #CedarRidgeBaptist #NewYear
Sunday at the Ridge: worship at 9:00 and 11:30, with Adult Sunday School at 10:15. Save us a seat and bring a friend. #SundayAtTheRidge
Missed Sunday? The full message is up at cedarridge.church. Watch it this week and share it with someone who needs it. #Vision2035
This Sunday we begin Vision 2035 and the Year Ahead, and we'll share the Lord's Supper together. Worship is at 9:00 and 11:30. #Vision2035
A new year doesn't need a new you. It needs the same faithful God. 🎬 Full message on YouTube. #CedarRidgeBaptist
“Write the vision; make it plain on tablets, so he may run who reads it.” (Habakkuk 2:2) Pray with us this week for the vision God is giving Cedar Ridge. #Vision2035
Your turn: what do you pray God does at Cedar Ridge by 2035? Tell us in the comments. We'll be praying over every answer. #Vision2035
This Sunday we come to the table together. “For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.” (1 Corinthians 11:26)
Sunday at the Ridge: worship at 9:00 and 11:30, with Adult Sunday School at 10:15. Save us a seat and bring a friend. #SundayAtTheRidge

New series! Building a Sending Church starts Sunday, January 17: ten weeks in the book of Acts about a church that gathers so it can go. 9:00 & 11:30. #BuildingASendingChurch
Vision isn't a slogan on a wall. 🎬 From Sunday's message, Vision 2035 and the Year Ahead. Full message on YouTube.
Our theme verse for the next ten weeks: “You will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.” (Acts 1:8) #BuildingASendingChurch
Where is God sending us? Swipe through the four circles of Acts 1:8, from our own city to the ends of the earth. 👉 #BuildingASendingChurch
Members, mark your calendars: Church Conference is Sunday evening, January 17. We'll hear reports, pray together and make decisions for the year ahead.
Sunday at the Ridge: worship at 9:00 and 11:30, Adult Sunday School at 10:15. This week we continue Building a Sending Church. #SundayAtTheRidge
